newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds stable but rate jitters remain.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds stable but rate jitters remain.

text.p: Austrian bonds stabilised at a higher level on Wednesday but traders say market jittery due to rate concerns.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down 30 bps at 99.10 to yield 5.75 (5.70) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.09/19 to yield 5.75/73 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 steady at 99.05 to yield 4.85 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.10/18 to yield 4.84/82 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 12 bps at 108.99.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at seven bps, five-year down nine bps at 20.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR slightly higher at 3.450 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38.
